ir.name: pairwise_contrastive_advantage_gap_weighted_logsigmoid_entropy_reg_repaired
ir.intuition: Contrastive pairwise loss weighted and normalized using advantage_gap and entropy regularization to stabilize training and improve ranking quality.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-8
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
advantage_gap = batch.get('advantage_gap', batch.get('advantage_l', zeros) - batch.get('advantage_w', zeros))

weight_exp = exp(weight)
total_exp = sum(weight_exp) + eps
norm_weight = weight_exp / total_exp
margin = clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw - lpl) + beta*advantage_gap, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(margin)
weighted_loss = loss * norm_weight
agg_loss = mean(weighted_loss)
weighted_adv = norm_weight * advantage_gap
adv_sum = sum(abs(weighted_adv)) + eps
adv_prob = weighted_adv / adv_sum
entropy_reg = gamma * (-sum(adv_prob * log(adv_prob + eps)))
final_loss = agg_loss + entropy_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
    advantage_gap = batch.get('advantage_gap', batch.get('advantage_l', zeros) - batch.get('advantage_w', zeros))

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('gamma', 0.1)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))

    weight_exp = ops.exp(weight)
    total_exp = ops.add(ops.sum(weight_exp), eps)
    norm_weight = ops.div(weight_exp, total_exp)

    margin = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
    margin = ops.clamp(margin, -20.0, 20.0)

    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, norm_weight)
    agg_loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)

    weighted_adv = ops.mul(norm_weight, advantage_gap)
    abs_weighted_adv = ops.abs(weighted_adv)
    adv_sum = ops.add(ops.sum(abs_weighted_adv), eps)
    adv_prob = ops.div(weighted_adv, adv_sum)

    adv_entropy = ops.neg(ops.sum(ops.mul(adv_prob, ops.log(ops.add(ops.abs(adv_prob), eps)))))
    entropy_reg = ops.mul(gamma, adv_entropy)

    final_loss = ops.add(agg_loss, entropy_reg)
    return final_loss
